senses.gloss: c. (preced. wds.) coarse web (of hemp), rough cloth.
units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 27b:4">M. Kat. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>והאידנא … אפי׳ בצ׳ בר זוזא</he> (Ar. <he>בצדרא בת</he>; Ms. M. 2 <he>בצְרָרָא</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 7) and nowadays people use for shrouds even rough cloth worth a Zuz; <cite ref="Ketubot 8b">Keth. 8ᵇ</cite> bot.—Pl. <he>צְרָדֵי</he>.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 60b:4">B. Mets. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>שרא למידק צ׳</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="R00129"><he>צדרא</he></cite>; Ms. F. <he>צדרי</he>; Ms. R. <he>צְרָרֵי</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) permitted to beat hemp-clothes (to improve their appearance).
